# Harbourside Bakery staff handbook

Harbourside Bakery is a fictional family bakery on the Esplanade in Cairns, Queensland. This handbook was written for automated tests and describes no real business.

## Opening the shop

The first baker arrives at 4:30 am. Switch on the deck ovens, check the proving cabinet is at 27 °C, and start the sourdough bake before the pastry. The front counter opens to customers at 6:30 am.

## Food safety

The cold room must stay between 1 and 5 °C. Record the cold room temperature on the clipboard at opening, midday and close. If the reading is above 5 °C, move dairy and cream fillings to the reach-in fridge and call the refrigeration contractor.

Label every tray of filling with the date it was made. Custard and cream fillings are discarded after 48 hours.

## Deliveries

Flour arrives from the mill every Tuesday and Friday before 7 am. Check the pallet against the invoice, rotate older stock to the front, and store bags off the floor on the slatted shelves.

## Closing

Unsold bread goes to the community pantry on Lake Street at 3 pm. Clean the slicer, mop the bakehouse floor and lock the flour store before leaving.
